claims.assertion: Yazhi describes Earth's 3D Matrix as a soul-experience system that repeatedly collapses when instability breaks its sustaining illusion; she says at least six prior civilizations were destroyed.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: Her account includes Atlantis and Lemuria among the more recent cycles.

claims.assertion: She says no Federation intervention will arrive; humanity's collective consciousness and choices shape Earth's Matrix and its evolution.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi says densities coexist, with a person's ideas and focus determining which reality and location they experience; mind generates time and distance.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
